messages:
maya: FYI seeing a small but steady spike of 502/504 from APAC. Traces point to requests being routed to eu-west after LB probe failures on apac-edge. Noticing SNAT port churn on the apac NAT gateway.

eduardo: do you have hc logs or the probe timestamps? could be transient flapping.

maya: paste of healthcheck lines:
```
2026-07-15T12:01:37Z INFO probe fail target=apac-edge-42 code=502 backend=nlb-apac check=/healthz latency=120ms
2026-07-15T12:01:38Z INFO probe fail target=apac-edge-42 code=502 backend=nlb-apac check=/healthz latency=118ms
2026-07-15T12:01:40Z INFO probe pass target=apac-edge-42 code=200 backend=nlb-apac
```

sarah: that pattern smells like probe window too tight + short backoff. LB marks unhealthy, traffic shifts to eu, increases cross-region egress => SNAT exhaustion.

jake: confirmed SNAT exhaustion metric spike at the same time. NAT port usage hit 62k for the apac pool. We saw ephemeral port reuse and connection resets.

eduardo: options: 1) increase probe success threshold / backoff on apac NLB 2) reduce session affinity so transient flaps don't pin flows to failing node 3) enable source-preserving routing via internal path if available 4) temporary scale-up of NAT pool (costy)

maya: I tried 1 locally in the staging NLB (increased healthy threshold from 2->4 and probe interval 5s->10s) and saw fewer failover events. But need to validate at scale.

sarah: long term we should avoid cross-region fallback for short probe windows. Add a probe grace window and a cooldown before geo-failover. This avoids paying for cross-region egress and reduces SNAT churn.

jake: +1. Also we can enable NAT port rotation and add secondary NAT pool as hot-warm to give breathing room. That reduces immediate cost of spinning up more infra.

maya: action items:
- increase probe backoff on apac NLB (maya)
- add 60s geo-fallback cooldown in routing policy (eduardo)
- create runbook snippet for SNAT hot-warm scaling and alert thresholds (jake)
- monitor cross-region egress bytes and NAT port usage for 24h (sarah)

eduardo: I'll push the routing policy change as a feature flag first. If it looks good we will roll to prod.

infra-bot: deploy started: patch/nginx-probe-tuning by eduardo. CI passed. :rocket:

maya: patch applied to apac canary, watching metrics. initial drop in failovers and ~30% reduction in cross-region egress. :eyes:

jake: noted cost impact: rough estimate saved ~ $420/day if sustained (cross-region egress avoided). we should add to weekly infra report.

sarah: also file follow-up: consider session affinity=none for control-plane endpoints. app traffic can handle reconnects; control-plane stickiness is costly here.

maya: thanks all. will update runbook and close the loop once 24h stable.

deploy-bot: monitor alert created: apac-nat-port-usage > 50k for 10m -> paging oncall.

eduardo: cheers, will keep an eye. :thumbsup:
